=== Day 1: the town meeting ===
Jory: "All right, listen up, everyone! Putting it out there right now: I am the Surveyor!"
Jory: "The night before you arrived, I learned that not everyone living on the Square shares the same alignment."
Jory: "From my window, I saw Isolde out in the street the night before you arrived."  [case board: #23, #24, #25]
Agnes: "I'll not keep secrets from my neighbors when we're in such need. I am the Clerk."
Agnes: "The night before you arrived, I learned that one of Dorian and Hollis is the Medium."  [case board: #26, #27]
Dorian: "I know everyone's going to read into my timing here, sorry, but I can't hold it back anymore: I am the Archivist."
Dorian: "The night before you arrived, I learned that one of Edda and Agnes is the Revenant."  [case board: #28, #29]
Agnes: "It troubles me to say it, neighbors, yet I don't trust Edda. Dorian's records tie them to the Revenant."
Agnes: "From my window, I saw Greta out in the street the night before you arrived."  [case board: #30, #31]
Edda: "No sense keeping the lid on the pot when the kitchen's smoking. I am the Rumormonger."
Edda: "The night before you arrived, I heard that one of Constance and Odette is Delusional, their gift a fancy."  [case board: #32, #33]
Greta: "I'll put my cards on the table so the rest of you stop squinting at me: I am the Rumormonger."  [case board: #34]
Constance: "In the interest of the town and proper order, I shall be plain: I am the Night Watch."
Constance: "The night before you arrived, I watched the Market: I saw Dorian pass by."  [case board: #35, #36]
Dorian: "Sorry to pile on, but I actually agree with Agnes about Edda. My own records tie them to the Revenant."  [case board: #37]
Odette: "Miraculously, Agnes and I are of one mind regarding Edda."  [case board: #38]
Hollis: "I concur with Agnes's assessment of Edda."  [case board: #39]
Lian: "I back Agnes's read on Edda."  [case board: #40]
